title: helianthemum marifolium var. dichroum
intro: Helianthemum marifolium var. dichroum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, known for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum marifolium var. dichroum include antispasmodic, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
